---
title: "Set up Claude Code"
subtitle: "About 10 minutes. Do it before the session if you can; we'll also do it together at the start."
---

::: {.callout-important}
## You need a paid Claude plan to follow along

Claude Code works with a **Pro, Max, Team, or Enterprise** plan, or a **Console** (API) account. **The free Claude
plan does not include Claude Code**, and NC State doesn't have a campus-wide license. We can't create accounts during
the session.

No paid plan? Come anyway. You can watch, or pair with a neighbor and be the person who checks the agent's work,
which is half the skill. Not sure what you have? Ask at [go.ncsu.edu/getdatahelp](https://go.ncsu.edu/getdatahelp)
before the session.
:::

## 1. Open a terminal

A terminal is a window where you type commands instead of clicking.

::: {.panel-tabset}
### Mac

Press {{< kbd mac=Cmd-Space >}}, type **Terminal**, and press {{< kbd Enter >}}.

### Windows

Press the {{< kbd win=Win >}} key, type **PowerShell**, and press {{< kbd Enter >}}. Your prompt starts with `PS C:\`.
:::

New to terminals? Anthropic's [terminal guide for new users](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/terminal-guide) walks
through it with pictures.

## 2. Install

Copy the line for your computer, paste it into the terminal, and press {{< kbd Enter >}}.

::: {.panel-tabset}
### Mac

::: {.prompt .prompt-shell}
```bash
curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash
```
:::

### Windows (PowerShell)

::: {.prompt .prompt-shell}
```powershell
irm https://claude.ai/install.ps1 | iex
```
:::

If you see `'irm' is not recognized`, you're in Command Prompt, not PowerShell. Use this line instead:

::: {.prompt .prompt-shell}
```bat
curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.cmd -o install.cmd && install.cmd && del install.cmd
```
:::
:::

The installer **shows no progress while it downloads**. Give it a minute.

## 3. Check it worked

**Close the terminal and open a new one** (so it finds the new command), then run:

::: {.prompt .prompt-shell}
```bash
claude --version
```
:::

You should see a version number, like `2.1.299 (Claude Code)`.

## 4. Sign in

Run `claude`. The first time, it asks you to pick a text style and sign in. Choose your Claude account, finish
signing in in the browser window that opens, and come back to the terminal. Type `/exit` to leave for now.

## If something goes wrong

| What you see | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| `command not found: claude` or `'claude' is not recognized` | Close the terminal and open a new one. Still missing? Run the install line again, then see [Fix your PATH](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/troubleshoot-install). |
| The install line fails (`403`, `syntax error near unexpected token '<'`) | Your network may be blocking the download. Try another network, or see [Troubleshoot installation](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/troubleshoot-install#find-your-error). |
| Signing in says your plan doesn't include Claude Code | You're on the free plan. Watch or pair up today; upgrading is your call. |
| A window offers to install "command line developer tools" (Mac) | Claude tried a tool your Mac doesn't have yet. **Not Now** is fine for today; **Install** takes 5–10 minutes. |
| Anything else | Run `claude doctor` in the terminal. It checks your install and suggests fixes. Inside Claude Code, `/doctor` can fix some problems for you. |

::: {.callout-tip}
## Rather not use a terminal?

The [Claude desktop app](https://claude.com/download) has a **Code** tab that runs Claude Code without one. Our
steps are written for the terminal, but the prompts work the same way there.
:::

## Before the session: get the starter folder

Download **one** of these and unzip it to your Desktop:

- [study-rooms.zip](downloads/study-rooms.zip): a campus library's study-room bookings
- [cafe.zip](downloads/cafe.zip): a campus café's daily sales

We'll tell you which one we're using live; the other works on your own afterward. Both hold made-up data.
